articles.title: Establishment of Parliament
articles.content: There shall be a Parliament for Bangladesh (to be known as the House of the Nation and in Bangla as Jatiya Sangsad) in which the legislative powers of the Republic shall be vested. Parliament shall consist of three hundred members elected directly from single territorial constituencies, with fifty seats reserved exclusively for women.

articles.title: Qualifications and disqualifications for election to Parliament
articles.content: A person shall be qualified to be elected to, and to be a member of, Parliament if he is a citizen of Bangladesh and has attained the age of twenty-five years.

articles.title: Vacation of seat on resignation or voting against political party
articles.content: A person elected as a member of Parliament at an election in which he was nominated as a candidate by a political party shall vacate his seat if he resigns from that party or votes in Parliament against that party.
